reviews.text: Super happy dog ​​and owner after first visit today🐶 Gentle, calm and skilled dog groomer🥳🥰

My dog ​​Klara went to Alba for her very first dog haircut at the hairdresser. I am super happy! Alba is amazing. She was incredibly good, listened to my wishes and took into account that this was my dog's first time. In addition, my dog ​​turned out really cute😍 Will definitely be back🥰
Our visit to Alba at Eira dog salon was very pleasant. Nervous Salto became very nice and happy with himself. We will be back.

Very happy with both the clip and the experience! ❤️ Such nice service, and Happy seemed both confident, happy and content after the visit. It's so good to find a dog salon where you feel like your dog is being well taken care of. We will definitely be back! 🐾🥰

Recommended!

Mille got a great haircut today and I can highly recommend Alba's expertise. Smooth and nice cut and Mille seemed very happy when she picked it up. A little higher price than expected, but we will still make the trip back, based on the service, skills and love shown to the little ones 🥰

Fantastic experience at Eira Hundesalong!
Delivered Mille for a haircut, and the result really exceeded expectations! Incredibly great and carefully done work, with an eye for detail. Mille turned out simply great!

What made the experience extra enjoyable was seeing how much Mille enjoyed herself. She quickly found the tone with the hairdresser, and it was clear that she felt safe and comfortable. That means at least as much as the result itself!

Here there is obviously both love for dogs and pride in the work that is done.

Highly recommended! We will definitely be back! 🐶❤️
Lovely experience! Super friendly staff and great service. Very pleased with the result.
Really happy with the haircut at Eira dog salon, Rio was safe and happy with the experience🥰 recommended!
Alba was really nice and good😊Lexy's fur was really nice afterwards and we were super happy. We will be back😊
Thank you so much, Alba, for taking so good care of Sissi!😍

Very happy with the treatment of Viktor! 🐾 Alba is an incredibly skilled and safe dog groomer who created a harmonious and calm atmosphere. Viktor was groomed in a gentle and professional manner, and I felt completely confident that he was in good hands.

Highly recommended – both for her professional skills and not least the nice way she takes care of the dog. ❤️

Had a 10/10 experience at Alba!

My dog ​​has been very nervous about grooming after an accident with scissors this spring. It was so bad that we actually had to go to the vet to have him clipped under sedation this summer. After other dog clippers have almost given up on him, I was therefore very excited to see how things would go at Alba today. At Alba, we were greeted with open arms and an absolutely fantastic understanding of both my needs and, most importantly, my dog's. She was able to clip his face, trim his claws and brush him.

I honestly had pretty low expectations of how much we were going to get done on such a first visit, so I was very happy when I came to pick him up and was greeted by a wagging, happy dog ​​who seemed to have made a new best friend. In addition, he was incredibly well-cut!!!!🥹

I highly recommend Alba, whether you have a dog who is extra nervous, finds grooming difficult, or just wants a really nice cut. A more genuine, caring and skilled dog person would be hard to find. I have been given hope that my boy can be cut again (without anesthesia).
Very good! Our Teddy received such good care and turned out great. Highly recommended 🌟
The good reviews are the reason we chose this salon, and they did not disappoint! We will definitely be back with our four-legged friend☺️🐾
We had our cocker spaniel here for the first time recently. We were pleasantly surprised. Both dog and owner were very happy with both the haircut and the service. Highly recommended!
Alba is absolutely amazing. Very good and kind with the dog. We have tried several and Alba is the best and it is worth the 50 minute drive. We highly recommend her ❤️

We are super happy with Eira Dog Salon at Oppsalsentet. Very calm and cozy salon, Alba was incredibly patient but otherwise a bit nervous guy. Clip was exactly what we wanted. We will be back! Recommended

Nova arrived at the salon with very matted fur, so I was a little worried about how it would turn out. I was so pleasantly surprised! The groomer was incredibly kind and did such an amazing job. Nova looked absolutely beautiful, and I’m so happy with the result! Highly recommend! ❤️
Very happy with the cut and wash.

Eira dog salon was easy to book an appointment with. Alba, who groomed Kokos, was very good. Kokos was very happy with Alba and didn't want to leave the salon. Eira offers grooming, and Kokos was groomed with good results.
Fantastically good staff, highly recommend Eira! Will come back here with our Pippi!
Very happy with Alba, we will be back😊
Great! We always go here
Nice and professional dog salon. The dog turned out great!

Both I and my dog, Truls (Australian Cobberdog), are very happy with the haircut, wash and claw trim at Eira Hundesalong😃 Truls had a great time being groomed by sweet Alba and mother really liked the result: perfect haircut done by a skilled dog groomer, Truls got exactly what I wanted👏 It's great to have a dog groomer within walking distance, we'll be back🥰 Truls and I can safely recommend Eira Hundefrisør. So to all dog people in the neighborhood around Oppsal, support Alba's newly started small business😍

We were at Eira Hundesalong for the second time today, and were just as satisfied this time as last time! Alba is incredibly warm, professional and skilled. She listens to what I want, while also seeing what the dog needs.

Both times I have felt that the dog has been well taken care of, and it has felt safe to leave him with her.

I can truly recommend Eira Hundesalong and Alba with all my heart – and we will definitely be back! ❤️
Our 5 month old king poodle had such a nice and safe experience at Alba's, and was absolutely beautiful. It was definitely beyond our expectations. Can't wait to come back!

Very satisfied. Both the cut and wash were very good. Incredibly nice ladies who know their craft. Kikki was not afraid to go in. Which shows good treatment. Highly recommended. Best dog wash after being in many places. Hope they continue this place for a long time. 😺😺😺
Highly recommended 🤩
Recommended! My dog ​​had an ultrasound of his abdomen but Grooms of Alba smoothed it out after shaving his abdomen. Otherwise, fine on Flatcoated retriever. Good with our senior dog.
Our little family dog ​​Luna was with you today, we were so happy 🥰 this is a dog salon I recommend.
Very nice service. They love animals and did a great job picking up Mio. It's demanding and a lot of work with Jack Russel terriers. Thumbs up 😇
Both Ibo and I are very happy with Eira dog salon. Ibo was well taken care of and groomed by two very good ladies. Ibo was so happy and satisfied when I came to pick him up. We will be back🥰

Alba clipped the claws and trimmed the paws of our King Poodle puppy. He is at the stage where he can quickly become quite hyper and snappy, but Alba handled him very well and returned a happy and contented newly groomed poodle! We will happily return for a full trim, she knows her poodle!
Superb loving and professional treatment. Choiva left her fear of water behind and enjoyed the spa day with Alba 🛁💅🌸

Noa needed quite extensive and demanding hand stripping, and we couldn’t be happier with the result.
They were meticulous, detail-oriented, and highly professional.
They took their time and gave him plenty of care and attention throughout the appointment.
It is clear that they understand the breed and genuinely care about the dog. Noa looks fantastic, and we felt completely confident that he was in excellent hands.
Highly recommended🐶🐶!

Professional and nice dog groomer who took good care of our little puppy. Our puppy got a good treatment and turned out so nice. In addition, we got good advice on what we should do ourselves. Really recommend a treatment here.

So happy with the service at Eira Hundesalong! Lovely and talented staff. Mia (our dog) was very happy to go in and looked amazing on collection! I've finally found an affordable and top class Hundesalong in Oslo!
Very good service, and they were good with my dog.

We had a very pleasant experience for the first time at a dog groomer with our 5 month old puppy.
Alba was calm, patient and kept me updated along the way. The puppy turned out absolutely beautiful and we are so happy.
Will definitely be back 🤩
Wow, such good and nice people!! Soft and smelled heavenly after care. Would recommend!!!
Very good service! We are super satisfied 🥰 thank you very much! …

Super nice girls! Listened to what I wanted, as I have a dog with a double coat but wanted a more practical cut than a show style. And got back a lucky ball of a teddy bear who had enjoyed the attention and lots of praise! Highly recommend them

Alba does a brilliant job washing and clipping my little maltipoo. She makes my dog ​​feel safe and I feel like I'm leaving her in the best hands. Alba's interest and commitment to taking into account the dog's needs and meeting them where they are is evident in her work. I highly recommend her!
Had our standard poodle cut here while we were on vacation in Oslo. Good service. Kind and pleasant people who run the salon. Very well done job! We were super-happy with the result.

Went to Eira dog salon today with Bella. There we were greeted by Alba with a big smile. She took the time to listen to Bella's challenges, sat down, gave Bella a treat and said hello. The place was very nice and seemed like a safe place for dogs. When I came back to pick Bella up, she was lying on a big, comfortable bed and relaxing. I got the impression that she had had a great time. I got an update on how the cut had gone and afterwards I was sent pictures. Both Bella and I are very satisfied and will definitely use Eira again. Recommended to everyone.

We regularly go to Alba for our dog's grooming, and we are always satisfied with both the haircut, service and the care of our dog. There was no doubt that we would also follow her to Eira. Alba is very skilled, and not least gentle and pleasant. We highly recommend her and Eira dog salon.
We have used them many times! And our dog is superhappy! The best groomer in town!
Indi & Nova always look so good after a visit to Alba. Recommended!
Our Jack Russel terrier turned out so nice😁Very nice place. Alba was very cozy. Will definitely come back here😁 …

Very happy! They welcome you and your dog very well when you come in.
Our dog was cut so nicely, and was really taken care of 🥰
Eira dog salon is really recommended!! 😁👍🏻 …
Very happy with the service! Paulina is incredibly nice, professional and good with dogs. My dog ​​felt safe and looked great after the visit. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Bambi's first haircut went incredibly well, Alba took great care of her and trimmed her face, ears and paws/claws perfectly.

We are so happy we found Eira and Alba, who have previously cut Milo. The fact that Eira has opened in Oppsal is just fantastic. Milo is cut to perfection and we are very happy. We will be back after the summer
Great clip of my Spanish Water Dog. Will be back.

Our Goldendoodle puppy has had his first haircut here (just over 4 months old), he was super nice and was both calm and happy when we picked him up.🤩 Claws, ears and fur look absolutely spotless! Leif Juster will definitely come back here.🙌🏼🥹❤️ Thank you so much, Alba and Paulina! …

Milo (11 weeks old) had his first trip to the hairdresser today. When I picked him up he was calm and happy 😀so it was a very positive experience for both dog and owner😀
We will definitely be back.
I can safely recommend Eira dog salon👍

Falk got his summer haircut at Alba's yesterday. Since he is a bit of a nervous dog, who takes time to become confident around people he doesn't know, I was extra excited when we visited Eira Hundesalong for the first time. However, there was no reason to be nervous. Not only was Falk very well looked after by Alba, but he also turned out very nice. Recommended! ☺️⭐️
We couldn’t be happier! Our girl isn’t a fan of being groomed, but Alba handled her with patience and care. Highly recommend!
Very sweet and nice hairdresser. We are very happy with the result 🤎 …
Absolutely fantastic! Alba was incredibly good with Poppy, and we couldn't be happier with the cliff. We will be more than happy to come back here
We were delighted with Sara and Mie's haircut. The dogs in focus♥️
We are very happy with the service, washing, clipping and brushing of our Eurasian. Alba was so good with Tasse - who is not very fond of either bathing or grooming. We highly recommend this place!

I had a wonderful experience at Eira. Alba was incredibly warm, kind, and professional, and she made both me and my dog feel comfortable from the moment we arrived. My dog can be a little sensitive, so it means a lot to find someone who creates a calm and safe environment.
I felt completely comfortable leaving my dog in her care, and it was clear that she genuinely cares about the dogs she works with. I would highly recommend Eira to anyone looking for a skilled groomer who treats every dog with patience, kindness, and respect.
Really happy with the haircut and how you treated our Bella, and very nice people 10/10 highly recommend.

Very happy!
When I dropped off my dog, I was greeted by a very nice, smiling and positive girl. She took the time before the clip to go over how I wanted the dog to look, and I immediately got a good feeling that my dog ​​was in safe hands. When I returned to pick up the dog, both girls were there, and they were incredibly nice and accommodating. They seem very calm, good and caring with the dogs. The result was great, and I am very happy with both the service, the way the dog was treated and the clip itself. Highly recommended!
Both Stella and I are very happy with the summer haircut at Eira dog salon! Nice result, nice and safe hairdresser and good price!

Would really recommend Eira Hundesalong! Went there today, on potestell with our hunting cocker spaniel. He was great and they are calm, professional and you can tell they love their job! We have found our permanent place🫶🏼 …
Paulina is an excellent groomer! We have a sheltie, and she always does a beautiful job. Our dog loves her too!

Our dog (DS) was great and so good that it can be plucked and cut, for the dog's best interest! Eira Dog Groomer with Alba is our savior! It is greatly appreciated that the dog's best interest is the most important thing! Thank you so much🤎 …

Fantastic service and wonderful staff! Odie always comes back looking beautiful and happy 🫶🏼 We trust them completely and can honestly say this is the best grooming salon in Oslo. Highly recommended! 💯 …
Cosy small pet groomer place. Very personalized service. Well connected by public transport. Good price. Probably best prices in Oslo. Spanish spoken too 😀 …
Easy access with parking, good bath, my dog was happy after, highly recomend 👍 …
Paulina is great. Coco loves her and she truly cares about the dogs she has in. She is knowleadgable and helpful as well. Strongly recommenf.
Had my 13 week old puppy there for a puppy introduction hour. Went great! The ladies took great care of my dog and I will be back again later this year 😊 …

Paulina has been cutting Holly's hair for several years, and we are very happy to have found a hairdresser that we trust, who gives good advice and always delivers a happy and beautiful dog! Highly recommend Paulina and Eira Hundesalong!
Best place we've taken our dog. 10/10 service. Our dog got to play with us at home. She barely wanted to leave😂 …

What an incredibly cozy salon! I gave Alba free rein to both cut and color, and the result was just amazing. 🤩 Fantastic service, lovely atmosphere and two super happy dogs who were so well taken care of. Highly recommended! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ …

My dog never had any bath with stranger and when we do it at home he is scared but with alba and heee loveed it. I love the the people working tjere and i am soo happy with results and i am coming back❤️❤️
Very good staff! Sonja (cockapoo) got a nice and even haircut, and was very happy when we picked her up. We will be back🥰 …
Highly recommended! Gizmo got his summer haircut at Alba's, and it turned out great❤️✂️ See you again!
Very satisfied! Nice staff who took care of both owner and dog. Also received training in nail clipping. Will be back!

Can really recommend Eira dog groomer❤️ Hector has been to Alba twice and he is so nice and very happy and satisfied afterwards😊 Both girls are calm, listen carefully to our wishes, communication both before and after is top notch and they take their time to make the dog feel safe❤️ At least we have found a permanent dog groomer in Oslo. Greetings Erica and Hector havanese🐾

Paulina and Alba are very professional and friendly, our little friend is always so happy after he goes to them💖😊 We are also very happy with the results and they always fill our requests🥰 We can’t recommend them enough! …
Eira hundesalong is exactly what I hoped for. Mila looked really nice after the haircut and grooming, and was so happy! Easy to get there from central Oslo. Recommended!
Thank you so much 💃🕺 …

Alba has cut our puppy Freia twice. The first time Freia had never seen scissors before and Freia was scared. Alba showed confidence and had great patience. She taught Freia that it is not dangerous to have her fur cut

Freia is very happy with Alba. It shows how good and confident Alba is, both in what she does and with dogs. She shows a care and understanding for dogs that makes our little puppy feel safe with Alba. Alba cut very carefully and we were so happy with the result! The fur is evenly and nicely cut, she got all the fur around the eyes removed, while leaving the eyelashes - which makes the result extra nice! We have received so many compliments on how nicely Freia is cut! I recommend cutting your dog at Alba! We will continue to cut Freia there❤️

Alba is an excellent professional groomer, we highly recommend her! She's always welcoming, warm and loves dogs and the dogs notice that very easily. She really nails the poodle cut and she is also so gentle and good at her job that our Luka loves to get his hair groomed by Alba, he's so relax that he's falling asleep when he's getting his hair cut! The result of her work is amazing - he looks like a true teddy bear afterwards!

The salon is perfectly located right in front of the metro station, which makes the commute there easy and convenient.

Fantastic dog salon! He was cut and groomed so nicely and well taken care of. Hugo doesn't really like baths and haircuts, but he was so calm and happy when I picked him up. Highly recommended. All-time girls and very good at haircuts and emotional support❤️

Alva gave Nanook - our dvergpuddel - a wonderful haircut. He looks really good and I’m super happy he’s clean and his fur is manageable again!
I met both girls at the salong and they were very nice and welcoming! Alva took her time with Nanook and I felt completely safe leaving him with her as I knew she would be gentle with him and take good care of him!
I have a very difficult dog to cut. Alba is the only one who can do it. She is calm and confident, patient and very caring. I always feel safe when I leave Lennart with her.
Easy access, very nice people, connected  very well with the dog, very good result. Will be used again. Bilbo (the dog, mediumpoodle 7months) - seemed very pleased with the stay.

Comfortable and great from a newly started company, recommended!
The world's best service and the best result I've ever experienced at a hair salon.
Will definitely come back, not just to support, but because of a very good result!

I highly recommend Alba at Eira Hundesalong.
The salon is fresh and inviting, you are warmly welcomed.
Our Biewer Terrier is cautious and insecure by nature, so it means a lot to meet a person who shows such great understanding, calmness and professionalism in her work. She has a unique approach and presence - she is the only dog ​​in our group who lets her claws be cut!
She takes her time, creates security and handles the dog in a very caring and respectful way. It is clear that she has both experience, knowledge and a genuine commitment to the well-being of the animals.
The experience has been very positive from start to finish, and I greatly appreciate the safe atmosphere she creates - for both dog and owner. I highly recommend her to anyone who wants a skilled and trustworthy dog ​​groomer.
Took the dogs to Eira at Oppsal Center today. Alva did a great job on their coats and both dogs are relaxed and happy as well as good looking!
Thank you so much for the great grooming and cutting of Theo (Westie). Will definitely be back 🤗🤗 …

I am very happy with my visit to Eira Hundesalong! 🐶✨
My dog ​​turned out exactly as I had hoped, so nice and well-groomed! They were incredibly good, caring and really took good care of him the whole time. The service and follow-up were top notch. 💛
I really appreciated all the cute details, like them taking nice pictures after the class and decorating him with accessories for May 17th 🇳🇴🥹

It made the whole experience even more special.
Highly recommended to anyone who wants professional treatment and lots of love for their dog! 🌸🐾

Very satisfied, Nala was calm and didn't have a bad time getting home after she finished!! Great and pleasant girls. Can be recommended.
Beate and Nala
Fantastic experience! My dog ​​had his nails trimmed very short and nicely, was washed and brushed thoroughly. Super friendly and professional service. Highly recommended!

We had Lucy at Eira dog salon today.
Lucy was very happy. We think she turned out very nice and ready for May 17th.
Can definitely recommend this salon.

I had both of my hunting spaniels at Alba's for a wash and cut before the summer. One doesn't like being groomed that much but Alba was so good with him and handled him with respect. She has a really nice way of handling insecure dogs. Both of them came out so nice and ready for the summer.

Very happy with Alba who has just opened Eira Hundesalong. Our dog is well taken care of and she always looks great! Highly recommended, we have gone to her many times, no matter where she has a salon.

Alba has been grooming my dog ​​for several years and there was no doubt that we would take her to Eira. She has a big heart for dogs and always makes sure that mine has a safe experience during the haircut. He has had some difficult experiences at dog groomers in the past, so his comfort is very important to me. He is always happy to see Alba and doesn't want to go home afterwards. The salon is easily accessible right next to the subway, and the place has a warm and cozy feeling.
Brilliantly skilled 100% smooth work.
I will highly recommend Paulinas cutting salong for dogs. They work efficient and my dog is always calm in their presence and the result is a happy dog with an amazing dog cut👌🙏😀 …

Paulina has been grooming Kobe since he was a puppy, and I have been very happy every time 🐶✨

I always feel safe when Kobe is in her hands, and it is noticeable that she really cares about the dogs she works with. She also gives good advice and tips on fur care and products, which I really appreciate💛

Paulina and Alba at Eira are amazing! They feel like family and have groomed my dogs for a couple years now. My dogs are so special to me and I’m very particular on who cares for them, with Paulina and Alba, I trust them so much! 💗💗💗 …

Fantastic place! I have been using Paulina for a long time now, and there is no one else I would rather leave my dog ​​with. Both girls are very attentive and you can tell right away that they love dogs. Although baths and haircuts can be stressful in themselves, Pablo is always incredibly well taken care of here. They have so much patience and put in a lot of play, so that he feels safe. I am always completely calm when Pablo is there, because I know the result will be perfect every single time. 5 stars from us!
Mozart looks both proud and happy after his visit to this dog groomer. We highly recommend them! Very good customer service as well!
Alba is great! Our Vinnie got a really nice summer haircut and there is no doubt that Alba has a really good team of dogs. We will definitely use Alba the next time Vinnie needs a haircut.
